title: Dinaturality of the compact-support frame pairing
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a finite extension E of Q_ℓ, schemes X and Y, a morphism a:X→Y with a compactification c, a coherent derived-system calculus S on X and a pairing system G as in [def-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing-constructions]. For arbitrary quotient-system derived objects M,M′,Q and any morphism f:M→M′, the actual G.beta satisfies dinaturality: mapping the tensor source by sections of RHom(f,Q) tensor identity and then applying beta(M,Q) equals mapping by identity tensor compact-support sections of f and then applying beta(M′,Q). This equality is in the derived category of strict R-module towers, before any finite evaluation, trace or inverse limit. No finite-Tor hypotheses are required.
